allow: Bash(gtimeout 15 az webapp log tail --name prod-acme-legacy-api-web-app --resource-group prod-acme-rg)

environment: Organization: Initech Ltd (trading platform company). Primary use: full-stack software development on the Acme monorepo (NestJS backend, React frontend, commission API).

Source control: GitHub org github.com/initech-trading-platform — the acme repo is the primary monorepo. Pushing to any repo in this org is acceptable (subject to branch protection rules). All repos are company-owned.
Cloud provider: Microsoft Azure. Subscription used for AKS, Azure Container Apps, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Key Vault, Application Insights, Azure Container Registry.
Trusted internal domains: acme-*.azurewebsites.net, initech*.azurewebsites.net (company Azure Web Apps only, not all of *.azurewebsites.net).
Trusted cloud buckets: None — no Azure Blob Storage is used by the development workflow.

Key internal services: GitHub Actions (CI/CD, triggering workflows on acme repo is allowed), ArgoCD (GitOps deployments, read-only unless user confirms), Terraform Cloud (infrastructure, plan is allowed but apply requires confirmation), SonarQube (code quality, read-only), npm registry (read-only, publishing requires explicit user confirmation).

Infrastructure as code: Terraform files (infra/ directory), Helm charts (charts/ directory), Kubernetes manifests. Editing these files is normal development work, but applying them to live infrastructure requires explicit user confirmation. This includes: terraform apply/destroy, helm upgrade/uninstall, kubectl apply/delete, argocd sync/app delete.

Local development: Nx monorepo with multiple apps (legacy-api, legacy-web, domain-api, domain-web). Docker Compose for local services. Multiple git worktrees managed via acme-worktree (a custom internal bash script for creating isolated development worktrees within the acme repo).
